drafts.angle: The customer outcome: close in two days instead of six
drafts.hook: Month-end close used to take our customers six working days. In our beta, the median was two.
drafts.text:
Month-end close used to take our customers six working days. In our beta, the median was two.

Most of those days went into one job: matching bank lines to invoices by hand.

Today we're releasing Auto-Match. It pairs bank transactions with open invoices as soon as they arrive.

40 finance teams used it in beta. Their median close went from six days to two.

It's on every plan from today, with no setup.

What would your team do with four days back every month?

#fintech
